title: Collatz: directed residue closure, ordinary returns and color variation
body:
## Problem and new result

Actual tripling disagreements still lack a complete closing estimate. This revision gives a **complete directed finite localization into 17 modulo 48**, formalizes its unrestricted ordinary reverse-basin consumer in Lean, and develops strict-return, interior-width and selected-color constraints. **Collatz remains open.**

Three GPT-6.2 Astra streams developed the attacks and cross-reviewed the resulting proofs. The coordinator reconstructed the arguments, independently replayed the finite certificate, rebuilt all local Lean dependencies and validated the exact published commit.

**[Scientific packet](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/README.md)** · **[execution and reviews](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/README.md)** · **[source ledger](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/SOURCES.json)** · **[coordinator reconstruction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/ROOT_REVIEW.md)**.

This checkpoint extends `b0538639df0ab7edd239281bd897e705160f732c` with **51 changed files: 49 additions and two navigation updates**. Earlier research packets remain intact. The [preceding complete PR description](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/PRIOR_PR_DESCRIPTION.json) is archived.

## 1. Complete directed residue closure

For an invariant binary label f, let D(r,m;a,b;X) count positive x through X with x = r mod m and ordered labels (f(x), f(3x)) = (a,b), where a differs from b. The finite certificate proves

```text
D(1,16;a,b;X) <= 1007 D(11,32;a,b;H X),
H = 574854143371 / 219537 < 2618500.
```

The 1,007 query positions are injective affine maps on their individual source progressions. This preserves power exponents and transfers unweighted reciprocal sums at constant cost. Exact ordinary orbit identities exchange the ordered labels at 32t+11 and 48t+17, giving the finer target 17 modulo 48. This replaces the preceding logarithmic-loss localization.

The certificate contains **116 motifs and 88 distinct paths**. Its avoiding-word counts at depths zero through ten are `1,3,9,25,54,65,58,27,8,1,0`. Every added tripling comparison points forward from 11 modulo 32. Lean checks the path semantics, literal numeric rows, midpoint congruences, complete word cover and unrestricted pointwise theorem. Two exact replays independently reconstruct the original-source accounting; the second checks all **59,049** complete length-ten cylinders.

With C the basin of 1, the complete new ordinary Lean consumer proves

```text
(every positive integer belongs to C)
  iff
(for every z = 17 mod 48, membership of 3z in C implies membership of z in C).
```

The consumer imports a byte-exact copy of PR146's directed descent module. The residue-wise implication on the right remains unproved. The opposite-direction criterion is a pinned written consequence; the full new kernel consumer proves the reverse equivalence displayed here.

Under a counterexample, the earlier two-sided reduction and published predecessor exponent transfer an **X^.84 lower population for the union of orientations** to 17 modulo 48 along an unbounded sequence of heights X. No claim that each orientation separately has that fine-residue exponent is made. Consequently an upper estimate D(17,48;X) = o(X^.84) would close this route. Unweighted summability also suffices under the separately qualified fixed-target density input M.

[Finite proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/BOUNDED_DIRECTED_ELEVEN.md) · [kernel localization](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/DirectedElevenLocal.lean) · [complete ordinary consumer](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/Residue17Closure.lean).

## 2. Smaller actual witnesses on the original source octave

For every actual defect in [X,2X) outside the stated original exceptional set, the construction finds an ordinary directed witness in each target residue. For the basin indicator its source is outside C and its triple is inside C.

| Original exceptional count | Witness height |
| --- | --- |
| O(X^(49/50)) | O(X^(24/25)) |
| O(X^(19/20)) | O(X^((94/149) log_2 3)), with exponent strictly below one |
| O_q(X^(h_2(log_3 2)) / sqrt(log X)) | At most qX for any fixed 0 < q < 1 |

Here h_2(log_3 2) is approximately 0.949955527. Both original parity rays are counted at one fixed clock; no fresh random law is assumed at a selected endpoint. These return estimates require neither P nor R. They extend the resident native no-descent calculation.

**The obstruction remains:** several sources may share a witness, and the smaller witness may belong to the next exceptional set. The exception exponent still exceeds .84. The proof supplies neither bounded multiplicity for the complete return map nor indefinitely repeatable descent.

[Fixed-factor proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/STRICT_RETURN_REFINEMENT.md) · [independent consumer/return review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/CONSUMER_AND_STRICT_RETURN_REVIEW.md).

## 3. Interior width budgets and delayed ties

On one original coarse binary grid, killing a signed native grade width at its first tie preserves its expectation. Strictly interior head intervals leave width unused, giving a conditional contraction 1-c/sqrt(V) per generation. The proof accounts for the bounded future lookahead used to certify an actual regeneration.

Under the pinned native merger and ordinary regeneration inputs P and R, on genuinely discordant originals, along the theorem's certified clock schedule, every choice of a true four-trit witness at its clocks has at least c d/(log d)^10 transitions with a grade tie, a failed endpoint margin or a reversal of the intervening cut order. A distinct theorem for fixed wider blocks removes the local reversal alternative. The original exception is O_A(R d^(-A)).

A complementary delayed-tie estimate removes any fixed positive fraction of bad late clocks outside superpolynomially small original mass. It does not eliminate early ties or the smaller frequency of failures forced by the width theorem. The persistent two-class case remains open.

[Width budget and lookahead](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/INTERIOR_GRADE_BUDGET.md) · [delayed ties](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/DELAYED_NATIVE_TIES.md).

## 4. Actual color patterns and ordinary variation

For a selected good discordant population of normalized mass w >= d^(-P), a chronological modal-reply argument and finite shattering construction produce common questions in distinct blocks. Every answer pattern is realized by actual sources in one opening cell. Each feature has its actual domain, one fixed coarse correction and a retained source census.

If V_i counts actual color changes along the common ternary progression in window i, every r-subset E obeys

```text
sum_{i in E} V_i >= 2^r - 1.
```

One can choose both a common ternary depth u and a number of disjoint windows k of order at least (d log d)^(1/8)/(log log d)^(1/4). At least half of the windows each contain at least c 2^(k/2)/k changes at the same gap 3^u, and at least as many adjacent-integer color changes. Window lengths are at most 2^(C sqrt(d log d)).

The inverse-polynomial source mass is essential; the .84 population bound alone does not supply it. Under M, a counterexample makes the normalized head-disagreement series diverge. Infinitely many rows then have mass at least d^(-2); finite suffix/orientation selection and the smaller good-envelope exception retain a population to which the theorem applies. **A contradictory upper variation estimate in these same selected windows is still missing.**

[Selected source tree](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/SELECTED_TRIT_CELLS.md) · [fixed questions](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/FIXED_TRIT_PATTERNS.md) · [ordinary variation](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/SELECTED_COLOR_VARIATION.md).

## Literature and neighboring work

The finite directed replacement builds on the Aaronson–Yolcu–Heule termination viewpoint and the repository's earlier ordinary descent certificates. It is not a terminating interpretation of their entire rewrite system. The color argument uses a finite Sauer-style inventory and, for separating distinct real windows, the fixed-two-logarithm specialization of Matveev. Exact references and their limited roles are in [the literature discussion](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/research/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/LITERATURE_AND_BOUNDARIES.md).

PR195's bounded unit reduction is credited as prior work. The refresh also read PR192's descent packet, PR193's deep-closure overview, and the two new PR201 manuscripts at `2978d84f8a1fda9083593b26c6bf724d5976d859`. PR201's directed covers reach either 1 or 5 modulo 6, while this certificate reaches the finer 17 modulo 48 class. Its stronger conditional suffix-series trigger and separate inverse-source amplification thresholds are recorded in the [late comparison](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/7ad81ec56947146fac854d2586651ca0c934a536/reports/ayh-resource-reset-20261124/directed-return/LATE_PR201_COMPARISON.md); those new manuscripts are not dependencies of this kernel build.

## Executed evidence and scope

- Fresh Lean 4.34.1 build, pinned Mathlib `d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612`, all local modules rebuilt in a fresh directory, `autoImplicit=false`, warnings as errors: **exit 0 in 239.321 seconds**.
- Audit of **82 explicitly public declarations**, including **14 earlier or vendored dependency statements**: only subsets of `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`.
- Both the source-accounting replay and independent whole-cylinder replay passed normally and under Python optimization. Each normal/optimized pair has identical stdout.
- Independent proof reviews pin the reviewed bytes. Source hashes bind all new science, preserved drafts and execution evidence. The five assembled reader-facing files have an additional signed wording review.

The arithmetic localization and complete reverse-basin equivalence are full kernel theorems. The quantitative source counting and analytic deductions retain written proof status. The finite Lean identities supporting the latter are not a formalization of their probability bounds. P and R are source-qualified where used; M appears only in the named summability consumer and conditional population trigger. Repository integrity is separate from mathematical verification.
